+++ b/internal/tracing/tracing.go
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func newResource(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*resource.Resource, error) {
+	return resource.New(ctx,
+		resource.WithSchemaURL(semconv.SchemaURL),
+		resource.WithAttributes(
+			semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt"),
+			semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String(fliptVersion),
+		),
+		resource.WithFromEnv(),
+	)
+}
+
+// NewProvider creates a tracer provider with Flipt's resource and always-on sampling.
+func NewProvider(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*tracesdk.TracerProvider, error) {
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, fliptVersion)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithResource(res), tracesdk.WithSampler(tracesdk.AlwaysSample())), nil
+}
+
+// GetExporter creates a tracing exporter and its shutdown function for this configuration.
+func GetExporter(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.TracingConfig) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("nil tracing configuration")
+	}
+
+	var (
+		exp tracesdk.SpanExporter
+		err error
+	)
+	switch cfg.Exporter {
+	case config.TracingJaeger:
+		exp, err = jaeger.New(jaeger.WithAgentEndpoint(
+			jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Jaeger.Host),
+			jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.Itoa(cfg.Jaeger.Port)),
+		))
+	case config.TracingZipkin:
+		exp, err = zipkin.New(cfg.Zipkin.Endpoint)
+	case config.TracingOTLP:
+		endpoint := cfg.OTLP.Endpoint
+		u, parseErr := url.Parse(endpoint)
+		if parseErr != nil {
+			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", parseErr)
+		}
+
+		var client otlptrace.Client
+		switch u.Scheme {
+		case "http", "https":
+			if u.Host == "" {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: missing host in %q", endpoint)
+			}
+			opts := []otlptracehttp.Option{otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(u.Host), otlptracehttp.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers)}
+			if u.Scheme == "http" {
+				opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithInsecure())
+			}
+			if u.Path != "" {
+				opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithURLPath(u.Path))
+			}
+			client = otlptracehttp.NewClient(opts...)
+		case "grpc":
+			if u.Host == "" || u.Path != "" {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: invalid gRPC address %q", endpoint)
+			}
+			client = otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+				otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+			)
+		default:
+			// url.Parse treats the host of a scheme-less host:port as a scheme.
+			if endpoint == "" || strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") || strings.ContainsAny(endpoint, "/?#") {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unsupported or invalid endpoint %q", endpoint)
+			}
+			if _, _, splitErr := net.SplitHostPort(endpoint); splitErr != nil {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", splitErr)
+			}
+			client = otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+				otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(endpoint),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+			)
+		}
+		exp, err = otlptrace.New(ctx, client)
+	default:
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported tracing exporter: %d", cfg.Exporter)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+	return exp, exp.Shutdown, nil
+}

+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "deployment.environment=test")
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	attrs := res.Set()
+	for _, want := range []attribute.KeyValue{semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt"), semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String("1.2.3"), attribute.String("deployment.environment", "test")} {
+		got, ok := attrs.Value(want.Key)
+		if !ok || got != want.Value {
+			t.Errorf("%s: got %v, want %v", want.Key, got, want.Value)
+		}
+	}
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "custom")
+	res, err = newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	got, _ := res.Set().Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey)
+	if got.AsString() != "custom" {
+		t.Errorf("service name = %s", got.AsString())
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewProvider(t *testing.T) {
+	provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = provider.Shutdown(context.Background()) })
+	if provider == nil {
+		t.Fatal("nil provider")
+	}
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "sampled")
+	if !span.SpanContext().TraceFlags().IsSampled() {
+		t.Error("span was not sampled")
+	}
+	span.End()
+}
+
+func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	var previous interface{}
+	cases := []struct {
+		name    string
+		cfg     config.TracingConfig
+		wantErr string
+	}{
+		{"jaeger", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6831}}, ""},
+		{"zipkin", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}, ""},
+		{"http", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}, ""},
+		{"https", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "https://localhost:4317"}}, ""},
+		{"grpc", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "grpc://localhost:4317"}}, ""},
+		{"bare", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "localhost:4317"}}, ""},
+		{"invalid", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://%zz"}}, "parsing otlp endpoint:"},
+		{"unsupported", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingExporter(99)}, "unsupported tracing exporter:"},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(ctx, &tc.cfg)
+			if tc.wantErr != "" {
+				if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), tc.wantErr) {
+					t.Fatalf("error = %v", err)
+				}
+				return
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if exp == nil || shutdown == nil {
+				t.Fatal("missing exporter or shutdown")
+			}
+			if exp == previous {
+				t.Fatal("exporter reused across independent configurations")
+			}
+			previous = exp
+			if err := shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestOTLPHTTPHeaders(t *testing.T) {
+	requests := make(chan *http.Request, 1)
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		requests <- r
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	}))
+	defer server.Close()
+
+	cfg := &config.TracingConfig{
+		Exporter: config.TracingOTLP,
+		OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{
+			Endpoint: server.URL + "/custom/traces",
+			Headers:  map[string]string{"api-key": "test-key"},
+		},
+	}
+	exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), cfg)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	provider := tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithSyncer(exp))
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "test")
+	span.End()
+	if err := provider.Shutdown(context.Background()); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := shutdown(context.Background()); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	select {
+	case r := <-requests:
+		if got := r.Header.Get("api-key"); got != "test-key" {
+			t.Errorf("api-key = %q", got)
+		}
+		if r.URL.Path != "/custom/traces" {
+			t.Errorf("path = %q", r.URL.Path)
+		}
+	default:
+		t.Fatal("exporter did not send a request")
+	}
+}

+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func newResource(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*resource.Resource, error) {
+	return resource.New(ctx,
+		resource.WithSchemaURL(semconv.SchemaURL),
+		resource.WithAttributes(
+			semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt"),
+			semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String(fliptVersion),
+		),
+		resource.WithFromEnv(),
+	)
+}
+
+// NewProvider creates a tracer provider with Flipt's resource and always-on sampling.
+func NewProvider(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*tracesdk.TracerProvider, error) {
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, fliptVersion)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithResource(res), tracesdk.WithSampler(tracesdk.AlwaysSample())), nil
+}
+
+// GetExporter creates a tracing exporter and its shutdown function for this configuration.
+func GetExporter(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.TracingConfig) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("nil tracing configuration")
+	}
+
+	var (
+		exp tracesdk.SpanExporter
+		err error
+	)
+	switch cfg.Exporter {
+	case config.TracingJaeger:
+		exp, err = jaeger.New(jaeger.WithAgentEndpoint(
+			jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Jaeger.Host),
+			jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.Itoa(cfg.Jaeger.Port)),
+		))
+	case config.TracingZipkin:
+		exp, err = zipkin.New(cfg.Zipkin.Endpoint)
+	case config.TracingOTLP:
+		endpoint := cfg.OTLP.Endpoint
+		u, parseErr := url.Parse(endpoint)
+		if parseErr != nil {
+			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", parseErr)
+		}
+
+		var client otlptrace.Client
+		switch u.Scheme {
+		case "http", "https":
+			if u.Host == "" {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: missing host in %q", endpoint)
+			}
+			opts := []otlptracehttp.Option{otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(u.Host), otlptracehttp.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers)}
+			if u.Scheme == "http" {
+				opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithInsecure())
+			}
+			if u.Path != "" {
+				opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithURLPath(u.Path))
+			}
+			client = otlptracehttp.NewClient(opts...)
+		case "grpc":
+			if u.Host == "" || u.Path != "" {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: invalid gRPC address %q", endpoint)
+			}
+			client = otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+				otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+			)
+		default:
+			// url.Parse treats the host of a scheme-less host:port as a scheme.
+			if endpoint == "" || strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") || strings.ContainsAny(endpoint, "/?#") {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unsupported or invalid endpoint %q", endpoint)
+			}
+			if _, _, splitErr := net.SplitHostPort(endpoint); splitErr != nil {
+				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", splitErr)
+			}
+			client = otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+				otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(endpoint),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.OTLP.Headers),
+				otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+			)
+		}
+		exp, err = otlptrace.New(ctx, client)
+	default:
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported tracing exporter: %d", cfg.Exporter)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+	return exp, exp.Shutdown, nil
+}

+func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "deployment.environment=test")
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	attrs := res.Set()
+	for _, want := range []attribute.KeyValue{semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt"), semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String("1.2.3"), attribute.String("deployment.environment", "test")} {
+		got, ok := attrs.Value(want.Key)
+		if !ok || got != want.Value {
+			t.Errorf("%s: got %v, want %v", want.Key, got, want.Value)
+		}
+	}
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "custom")
+	res, err = newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	got, _ := res.Set().Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey)
+	if got.AsString() != "custom" {
+		t.Errorf("service name = %s", got.AsString())
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewProvider(t *testing.T) {
+	provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = provider.Shutdown(context.Background()) })
+	if provider == nil {
+		t.Fatal("nil provider")
+	}
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "sampled")
+	if !span.SpanContext().TraceFlags().IsSampled() {
+		t.Error("span was not sampled")
+	}
+	span.End()
+}
+
+func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	var previous interface{}
+	cases := []struct {
+		name    string
+		cfg     config.TracingConfig
+		wantErr string
+	}{
+		{"jaeger", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6831}}, ""},
+		{"zipkin", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}, ""},
+		{"http", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}, ""},
+		{"https", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "https://localhost:4317"}}, ""},
+		{"grpc", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "grpc://localhost:4317"}}, ""},
+		{"bare", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "localhost:4317"}}, ""},
+		{"invalid", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://%zz"}}, "parsing otlp endpoint:"},
+		{"unsupported", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingExporter(99)}, "unsupported tracing exporter:"},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(ctx, &tc.cfg)
+			if tc.wantErr != "" {
+				if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), tc.wantErr) {
+					t.Fatalf("error = %v", err)
+				}
+				return
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if exp == nil || shutdown == nil {
+				t.Fatal("missing exporter or shutdown")
+			}
+			if exp == previous {
+				t.Fatal("exporter reused across independent configurations")
+			}
+			previous = exp
+			if err := shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestOTLPHTTPHeaders(t *testing.T) {
+	requests := make(chan *http.Request, 1)
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		requests <- r
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	}))
+	defer server.Close()
+
+	cfg := &config.TracingConfig{
+		Exporter: config.TracingOTLP,
+		OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{
+			Endpoint: server.URL + "/custom/traces",
+			Headers:  map[string]string{"api-key": "test-key"},
+		},
+	}
+	exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), cfg)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	provider := tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithSyncer(exp))
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "test")
+	span.End()
+	if err := provider.Shutdown(context.Background()); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := shutdown(context.Background()); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	select {
+	case r := <-requests:
+		if got := r.Header.Get("api-key"); got != "test-key" {
+			t.Errorf("api-key = %q", got)
+		}
+		if r.URL.Path != "/custom/traces" {
+			t.Errorf("path = %q", r.URL.Path)
+		}
+	default:
+		t.Fatal("exporter did not send a request")
+	}
+}
